configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that is shown in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server Short Name
configurationFields.description: Sets an optional short name for the server. Maximum 32 characters

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Sets an optional description for the server that is visible in the server browser when the server is selected. Maximum 4096 characters

configurationFields.label: Server Contact
configurationFields.description: Sets an optional contact email address or website (where players may contact the server owner)

configurationFields.label: Show In Server List
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be visible in the server list

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: Sets a semicolon-separated list of UIDs of server admins

configurationFields.label: Custom Server Header Image
configurationFields.description: Sets a relative path to an optional server header image (shown in the server browser if a user selects the server). Recommended size: 1024x512 px

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will only accept players whose UIDs are in the 'whitelist' file

configurationFields.label: Enable Blacklist
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will block all players whose UIDs are in the 'blacklist' file

configurationFields.label: Use Reserved Names
configurationFields.description: If set, the server ensures that no player uses a reserved name (unless their UID matches)

configurationFields.label: Disable Conversion Savepoints
configurationFields.description: If set, SQLite won't set up a savepoint or use a transaction when performing a world conversion

configurationFields.label: Enable Port Check
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will check if any of the server ports (UDP and TCP) are already in use

configurationFields.label: Server Target Framerate
configurationFields.description: Sets the server target framerate (only affects the main thread)

configurationFields.label: Steam Reconnect Attempts
configurationFields.description: Sets how often Steam tries to reconnect after losing connection. -1 = unlimited retries

configurationFields.label: Log Retention Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the period after which old server logs should be deleted. -1 = keep all

configurationFields.label: Weltname
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the world to load, or to create if it does not exist

configurationFields.label: Welt-Seed
configurationFields.description: Sets the seed used to create a new world. Empty = random seed

configurationFields.label: World Creation Game Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the default world game mode when creating a new world

configurationFields.label: Flat World Terrain Elevation
configurationFields.description: Sets the default elevation of terrain in newly created superflat worlds

configurationFields.label: Flat World Terrain ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the default terrain ID for newly created superflat worlds

configurationFields.label: World Flatness Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the world flatness factor when creating a new world

configurationFields.label: World Ore Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the world ore amount when creating a new world

configurationFields.label: Create Backup Before Conversion
configurationFields.description: If set, the game will automatically create a backup of the world when performing a conversion (after an update)

configurationFields.label: Disabled NPCs
configurationFields.description: Sets an optional comma-separated list of disabled NPCs

configurationFields.label: Disable Caves
configurationFields.description: If set, caves will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Ocean (Water)
configurationFields.description: If set, the ocean (water) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Vegetation
configurationFields.description: If set, vegetation will be disabled

configurationFields.label: World Terrain Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the world terrain type. Example: 'Default', 'Superflat' or 'FlatIslands'

configurationFields.label: Save World
configurationFields.description: If disabled, the game will no longer save world changes

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode to run the server with

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Enable Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, the global chat will be active

configurationFields.label: Show Emojis In Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, emojis will be shown in chat (depending on player permissions)

configurationFields.label: Chunk Life Span
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period until an unused chunk gets disposed. Low values reduce memory consumption, high values improve performance

configurationFields.label: Chunk Worker Threads
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of chunk worker threads. 0 = automatic assignment

configurationFields.label: Cooking Duration Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor to modify the duration it takes to cook or process food. Example: 0.5 = cooking takes half the time

configurationFields.label: Enable Crafting Progression
configurationFields.description: If set, crafting progression is enabled, meaning recipes need to be unlocked first before they're available

configurationFields.label: Dead Body Despawn Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time until dead bodies despawn

configurationFields.label: Delete World Event Logs Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the period after which old world event entries will be deleted. -1 = keep all entries

configurationFields.label: Gravity Affects Objects
configurationFields.description: If set, floating objects (like furniture) break under certain circumstances

configurationFields.label: Gravity Affects Plants
configurationFields.description: If set, floating plants break under certain circumstances

configurationFields.label: Hunger Thirst Duration Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor to modify the duration until a player gets hungry/thirsty. Smaller values make the player more hungry/thirsty

configurationFields.label: Illegal State Limit
configurationFields.description: If too many illegal states are detected for a player, they will be kicked from the server

configurationFields.label: Item Despawn Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time until a dropped item despawns

configurationFields.label: Item Durability Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor for how durable items are. Examples: 2 = items are twice as durable, 0.5 = half durability. -1 = infinite durability

configurationFields.label: Log World Events
configurationFields.description: If set, player world events (such as placing or removing elements or terrain) will be tracked and logged

configurationFields.label: Map Tile Resolution
configurationFields.description: Sets the resolution of a map tile (per sector). High values consume more memory (and more VRAM on clientside)

configurationFields.label: Maximum NPCs
configurationFields.description: Sets how many NPCs are allowed on the server. -1 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Moon Phase
configurationFields.description: Sets an optional pre-defined moon phase. If set, this moon phase will always be active. Empty = varying moon phases

configurationFields.label: Moon Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the scale factor for the moon

configurationFields.label: NPCs Drop Equipped Items
configurationFields.description: If set, killed NPCs will drop their equipped items

configurationFields.label: NPC Enemy Respawn Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown until the game tries to respawn enemy npcs (monsters, bandits) in a chunk

configurationFields.label: NPC Hit Damage Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor for the damage dealt by NPCs

configurationFields.label: NPC Respawn Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown until the game tries to respawn NPCs in a chunk

configurationFields.label: NPC Spawn Monsters At Surface
configurationFields.description: If set, monsters will spawn at the surface at night. They will disappear at dawn

configurationFields.label: NPC Spawnrate For Animals
configurationFields.description: Sets the spawn rate for animals. Lower values for less animals, higher values for more

configurationFields.label: NPC Spawnrate For Bandits
configurationFields.description: Sets the spawn rate for bandits and similar enemies. Lower values for less enemies, higher values for more

configurationFields.label: NPC Spawnrate For Surface Monsters
configurationFields.description: Sets the spawn rate for surface monsters during night. Lower values for less enemies, higher values for more

configurationFields.label: NPC Spawnrate For Underground Monsters
configurationFields.description: Sets the spawn rate for monsters which spawn underground (dungeons, hell etc). Lower values for less enemies, higher values for more

configurationFields.label: Surface Skeletons Have Torch
configurationFields.description: If set, surface skeletons will spawn with a torch at night (making them more visible)

configurationFields.label: Object Recover Time
configurationFields.description: If a floating object breaks, it will spawn as an item if its place time is less than this value

configurationFields.label: Ore Smelting Duration Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor to modify the duration it takes to smelt ores. Example: 0.5 = smelting takes half the time

configurationFields.label: Override Deep Underground Location Name
configurationFields.description: Sets an override for the deep underground location name ('Deep Underground')

configurationFields.label: Override Default Location Name
configurationFields.description: Sets an override for the default location name ('Wilderness')

configurationFields.label: Override Hell Location Name
configurationFields.description: Sets an override for the hell location name ('Hell')

configurationFields.label: Override Orbit Location Name
configurationFields.description: Sets an override for the orbit location name ('Orbit')

configurationFields.label: Override Underground Location Name
configurationFields.description: Set an override for the underground location name ('Underground')

configurationFields.label: Pack World Item Stacks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will try to merge world items when spawning several at once (performance reasons)

configurationFields.label: Enable Peaceful Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, peaceful mode will be active, meaning enemies do not attack (unless provoked)

configurationFields.label: Pickup On Deconstruct
configurationFields.description: If set, blocks will be picked up automatically when deconstructing them with a sledgehammer

configurationFields.label: Plant Growth Duration Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor to modify the duration it takes for plants to grow. Example: 0.5 = growth is twice as fast

configurationFields.label: Player List Shows Distance
configurationFields.description: If set, the player list (i) will show the distance to other players

configurationFields.label: Player List Shows Permission Group
configurationFields.description: If set, the player list (i) will show the permission group of other players

configurationFields.label: Player List Shows Play Time
configurationFields.description: If set, the player list (i) will show the total playtime of other players

configurationFields.label: Player Undo Steps
configurationFields.description: Sets how many 'undo' steps are tracked per player

configurationFields.label: Player Undo Time
configurationFields.description: Sets how long an undo step is valid

configurationFields.label: Play Heartbeat Sound On Attack
configurationFields.description: If set, players will hear a heartbeat sound when being detected by a hostile NPC

configurationFields.label: Advertise PvE
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be advertised as a PvE server (this alone does not affect the gameplay)

configurationFields.label: Advertise PvP
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be advertised as a PvP server (this alone does not affect the gameplay)

configurationFields.label: Enable Regional Weather
configurationFields.description: If set, there will be different weather per region (each region overrides the global weather)

configurationFields.label: Enable Seasons
configurationFields.description: If set, seasons will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Show General Messages
configurationFields.description: If set, general messages (time of day or weather changed) will show up in the chat

configurationFields.label: Show Location Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets how long the current location should be shown to the player. -1 = always show the location

configurationFields.label: Show Player Connect Message
configurationFields.description: If set, all players will be notified when a player connects to the server

configurationFields.label: Show Player Death Message
configurationFields.description: If set, all players will be notified when a player dies

configurationFields.label: Show Player Death Message Reason
configurationFields.description: If set, all players will see why a player died (only if Show Player Death Message is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Show Player Disconnect Message
configurationFields.description: If set, all players will be notified when a player leaves the server

configurationFields.label: Show Players On Map
configurationFields.description: If set, all players will be visible on the in-game map

configurationFields.label: Show Restart Reminder
configurationFields.description: If set, a restart reminder will be sent to all admins if the server is running for more than 24 hours

configurationFields.label: Skip Loading Allowed
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to skip the loading screen when connecting to the server

configurationFields.label: Sky Rotation
configurationFields.description: Sets the optional rotation (in degrees) of the sky (determines where the sun rises and sets)

configurationFields.label: Spawn Chest Items On Destroy
configurationFields.description: If set, chests will spawn all their content as world items if a player breaks them. May have performance implications

configurationFields.label: Spawn Protection Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the player spawn protection period. Newly spawned players won't get attacked by NPCs during the spawn protection period

configurationFields.label: Starting Weather
configurationFields.description: Sets the initial weather effect (such as 'fog', 'rain' etc). Empty = default weather

configurationFields.label: Day Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the duration (in real time) of one in-game day

configurationFields.label: Water Update Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets how often flowing water should be updated. 0 = disable flowing water

configurationFields.label: Water Update Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets how often flowing water updates should be synced with clients

configurationFields.label: Water Worker Threads
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of water worker threads (responsible for handling water updates). 0 = automatic assignment

configurationFields.label: Weather Duration Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the factor to modify the time until the weather changes. Example: 0.5 = weather changes twice as frequently

configurationFields.label: Weather Preset
configurationFields.description: Sets the weather preset

configurationFields.label: Enable In-Memory Database
configurationFields.description: If set, the database runs in RAM (faster) and is only stored periodically on disk. Increases memory usage

configurationFields.label: In-Memory Database Save Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the save interval for the database being saved to disk when using the in-memory database

configurationFields.label: Journal Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the journal mode. It's recommended to use WAL (Write-Ahead Logging)

configurationFields.label: Synchronous Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the synchronous mode

configurationFields.label: RCON aktivieren
configurationFields.description: If set, the RCON tool will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable RCON API Only
configurationFields.description: If set, allows the use of a custom RCON tool (disables the built-in RCON tool)

configurationFields.label: RCON Certificate
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON certificate path (relative to the server directory)

configurationFields.label: RCON Certificate Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON certificate password

configurationFields.label: RCON IP Binding
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON IP binding. Empty = default server IP

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for RCON login. Minimum 6 characters

configurationFields.label: RCON Whitelist IP
configurationFields.description: Sets a semicolon-separated lists of IPs that can access the RCON tool

configurationFields.label: Enable Plugins
configurationFields.description: If true, plugins will be loaded. If disabled, no Java VM will be created

configurationFields.label: Plugin Memory
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of heap memory for the Java VM

configurationFields.label: Java VM Options
configurationFields.description: Sets a semicolon-separated list of Java VM options

configurationFields.label: Debug Plugin Events
configurationFields.description: If true, the game will track event call durations and also detects infinite loops in plugin event methods

configurationFields.label: Debug Events Duration Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowed duration of event calls until a log message is printed. Debug Plugin Events must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Plugin Error Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of plugin errors until the server throws an exception

configurationFields.label: Suppress Fatal Error Logs
configurationFields.description: If set, the Java VM will not generate hs_err_pid files in case of a native crash

configurationFields.label: Default New Player Permission Group
configurationFields.description: Sets the default permission group for new players. Empty = default permissions

configurationFields.label: Give Admins Full Permissions
configurationFields.description: If set, server admins get full permissions, irrespective of their actual permission group

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. Update the server after switching branches
